intro: The winless Chargers finally got a win, and the Ravens are searching for answers with Lamar Jackson on injured reserve. Sunday brings the Bills against Miami, the Jaguars at the Giants and the Vikings and 49ers in prime time, while the Packers and Rams get the first Thanksgiving Eve game of the week. 160 stories across all 32 teams.

top.label: Biggest Story
top.headline: Chargers beat the Ravens 23-20 for their first win of the season
top.dek: Los Angeles beat Baltimore on Monday night after eight straight losses. The Chargers scored on their first drive, never trailed and played their first turnover-free game of the year. Jim Harbaugh said he wants to win every week.

top.label: Injury Watch
top.headline: Ravens lose two linemen as Lamar Jackson stays on injured reserve
top.dek: Jackson is out with a thumb injury, so Jacoby Brissett remains the starter. Right guard Vega Ioane (shoulder) and defensive tackle Nnamdi Madubuike (hamstring) left Monday's game and did not return. Baltimore visits Carolina on Sunday.

top.label: Player Spotlight
top.headline: Ja'Marr Chase catches 11 passes for 231 yards against Pittsburgh
top.dek: Chase torched the Steelers with 11 receptions and 231 yards in the Bengals' 38-18 win. He now sits 122 yards short of a sixth straight 1,000-yard season, and Cincinnati plays Washington on Monday night.

top.label: Stat of the Day
top.headline: +125: Jaguars own the NFL's best point differential
top.dek: Jacksonville also leads the league with a +9 turnover margin, and Trevor Lawrence has 21 touchdown passes against 5 interceptions. A 30-point game at the Giants today would give the Jaguars a franchise-record fifth in a row.

top.label: What's Next
top.headline: Packers visit the Rams on Netflix the night before Thanksgiving
top.dek: Green Bay is on a bye this week, then plays at SoFi Stadium on Wednesday at 8 p.m. ET. It is only the second Wednesday regular-season game in franchise history. Watch Micah Parsons' status.

teams.name: Buffalo Bills
teams.headline: Bills hit 8-1 and host Miami

stories.text: Bills run past the Jets to improve to 8-1
stories.summary: Buffalo beat the Jets 31-12 at MetLife Stadium in Week 10. Josh Allen threw for 196 yards and a touchdown and ran for two more scores, and James Cook closed the game with 74 of his 157 rushing yards in the final five minutes. The Bills now share the league's best record with San Francisco.

stories.text: Benford and Williams out, Kincaid doubtful vs. Miami
stories.summary: Cornerback Christian Benford (groin) and linebacker Dorian Williams (calf) are out for Sunday. Tight end Dalton Kincaid (thumb and ankle) is doubtful, and safety Damar Hamlin (toe), tight end Jackson Hawes (shoulder) and lineman T.J. Sanders (shoulder) are questionable. Safety Cole Bishop is also working through a shoulder issue.

stories.text: James Cook keeps stacking 75-yard games
stories.summary: Cook ran for 157 yards against the Jets, his eighth straight game with at least 75 rushing yards and a rushing touchdown. Only four other players in NFL history have matched that run. He enters Sunday with 971 rushing yards, second in the league and close to 1,000.

stories.text: 11: Josh Allen's rushing touchdowns lead the NFL
stories.summary: Allen has 11 rushing touchdowns, the most in the league. Against Miami in his career he has 4,256 passing yards, 42 touchdown passes and 5 rushing scores in 16 games. Buffalo has won 14 of the last 16 meetings in the series.

stories.text: Sunday vs. Miami, 1 p.m. ET on CBS
stories.summary: Buffalo hosts the 1-8 Dolphins at Highmark Stadium in Week 11, and the game also streams on Paramount+. Miami has lost 10 straight games in Buffalo, and the Bills' second-ranked run game faces a defense that has allowed 100 rushing yards to six straight opponents.

teams.name: Miami Dolphins
teams.headline: Missed kicks sink Miami in a 24-22 loss

stories.text: Three missed kicks doom Dolphins against Indianapolis
stories.summary: Miami lost 24-22 to the Colts in Week 10 for its third straight defeat. Kicker Zane Gonzalez missed field goals from 47 and 51 yards, both wide left, plus an extra point. The 51-yarder in the fourth quarter would have given the Dolphins the lead.

stories.text: Brewer questionable as the injured list keeps growing
stories.summary: Center Aaron Brewer (concussion) is questionable, and punter Bradley Pinion (groin) and receiver Jared Wayne (quadriceps) are out. Running back De'Von Achane, quarterback Malik Willis and defensive tackles Zach Sieler, Jordan Phillips and Zeek Biggers are all on injured reserve.

stories.text: Kyle McCord makes his first NFL start
stories.summary: McCord replaced the injured Malik Willis and went 17 of 32 for 209 yards with no touchdown passes and no interceptions. He ran for a touchdown but lost a fumble that Indianapolis returned for a score. He starts again Sunday at Buffalo.

stories.text: 10: straight losses for Miami at Highmark Stadium
stories.summary: The Dolphins have dropped 10 consecutive games in Buffalo. They also have allowed six straight opponents to rush for at least 100 yards, and James Cook and the Bills rank second in the league in rushing offense at 152.7 yards per game.

stories.text: At Buffalo on Sunday, 1 p.m. ET on CBS
stories.summary: Miami visits the 8-1 Bills in Week 11. Watch whether McCord can protect the ball and whether the Dolphins can slow a Buffalo ground game that leads with Cook and Josh Allen.

teams.name: New England Patriots
teams.headline: Maye's ankle clouds Patriots' bye week

stories.text: Drake Maye hurt, Patriots head into the bye at 5-5
stories.summary: New England lost 35-10 to Detroit in Munich after Maye hurt his ankle on the opening drive. Coach Mike Vrabel said he could not imagine Maye being available coming out of the bye. Detroit gained 494 yards, the most the Patriots have allowed this season.

stories.text: Brown, Stevenson and Moses all banged up in Munich
stories.summary: Receiver A.J. Brown returned from a two-game knee absence, caught two passes, then left with a hamstring injury. Running back Rhamondre Stevenson played through a knee injury, and right tackle Morgan Moses briefly left with a knee issue. Vrabel called Maye's injury a lower leg injury.

stories.text: Tommy DeVito steps in for Maye
stories.summary: DeVito went 12 of 24 for 81 yards with one touchdown pass to Lan Larison and one interception after Maye left. Maye had completed 3 of 4 passes for 48 yards before the injury.

stories.text: 1.8: yards per play for the offense after Maye left
stories.summary: Without Maye, New England managed 81 total yards on 45 plays. The line used its sixth different combination of the season, and quarterbacks faced pressure on 48.6 percent of dropbacks.

stories.text: On bye in Week 11, then at the Chargers on Nov. 29
stories.summary: New England is off this weekend. The Patriots visit the Los Angeles Chargers on Nov. 29, and the quarterback question is the story to track until then.

teams.name: New York Jets
teams.headline: Jets wait on Geno Smith's ankle at the Chargers

stories.text: Geno Smith's ankle is the Jets' week
stories.summary: Smith hurt his left ankle in the third quarter of the 31-12 loss to Buffalo after a head evaluation earlier in the game. Imaging showed no serious injury, but coach Aaron Glenn would not commit to him starting. Rookie Cade Klubnik is the fallback.

stories.text: Smith limited, says 'That's the plan' to play
stories.summary: Smith was limited in a walk-through while limping on the ankle, and said his plan is to play at the Chargers. A source said his X-ray and MRI showed no significant damage. He also described other aches and pains from the hits he took against Buffalo.

stories.text: Harrison Phillips posts 10 tackles against Buffalo
stories.summary: The Jets defensive lineman set a season high with 10 tackles, including eight run stops. It was the most tackles by a Jets defensive tackle since Damon Harrison had 12 in 2015, and his eight run stops lead the team this season.

stories.text: 0-9: Aaron Glenn's record against the AFC East
stories.summary: After the loss to Buffalo, Glenn is 5-22 in two seasons and winless in nine games against division opponents. The Jets have lost five straight, and kicker Jason Sanders has accounted for all of their points in the last two games.

stories.text: At the Chargers, 4:05 p.m. ET Sunday on FOX
stories.summary: The Jets visit SoFi Stadium for a game against the 1-8 Chargers. Justin Herbert has thrown 11 interceptions and the Chargers allow 26.6 points per game, so the Jets' ground game, held to 109 yards by Buffalo, needs to produce.

teams.name: Baltimore Ravens
teams.headline: Ravens lose a fifth straight to the Chargers

stories.text: Winless Chargers beat Ravens for a fifth straight Baltimore loss
stories.summary: Los Angeles won 23-20 on Monday night at M&T Bank Stadium for its first victory of the season. Baltimore has now dropped five in a row, its longest skid since 2021, and sits 4-6. Zay Flowers fumbled inside the final two minutes with the Ravens down three.

stories.text: Jackson on IR as Ioane and Madubuike leave the Chargers game
stories.summary: Lamar Jackson is on injured reserve with a thumb injury, so Jacoby Brissett is the starter. Right guard Vega Ioane (shoulder) and defensive tackle Nnamdi Madubuike (hamstring) left Monday's game and did not return. Chuma Edoga replaced Ioane.

stories.text: Brissett throws for 340 yards in his Ravens debut
stories.summary: Jacoby Brissett, acquired by trade, completed 33 of 49 passes for 340 yards and one interception against the Chargers. The Ravens still lost, and the run game gave him little help with 16 team rushing yards.

stories.text: 16: Ravens rushing yards, a season low in the loss
stories.summary: Baltimore ran for 16 yards as a team and had zero rushing yards in the first half, a franchise low. Derrick Henry carried 10 times for 10 yards and scored twice. He has been held under 100 yards in five straight games, the first such stretch since he joined the Ravens in 2024.

stories.text: Ravens visit Panthers on Sunday looking to end the skid
stories.summary: Baltimore plays at Carolina on Sunday, Nov. 22, at 1 p.m. ET on FOX. The Panthers are 4-5 and lead the NFC South. Brissett is 3-0 against Carolina, and Henry is averaging 69.9 rushing yards per game.

teams.name: Cincinnati Bengals
teams.headline: Bengals take AFC North lead behind Burrow and Chase

stories.text: Bengals beat Steelers 38-18 to take sole lead of the AFC North
stories.summary: Cincinnati improved to 7-2 on Sunday night and moved ahead of 6-3 Pittsburgh in the division. The Bengals led 24-3 at halftime and 31-3 entering the fourth quarter. Neither team turned the ball over.

stories.text: Burrow practices fully through illness before Monday night
stories.summary: Joe Burrow went full in practice all three days with an illness and carries no game status. Guard Dalton Risner (knees) and linebacker Oren Burks (groin) are out. Safety Kyle Dugger, guard Dylan Fairchild and cornerback Dax Hill are questionable.

stories.text: Ja'Marr Chase catches 11 passes for 231 yards
stories.summary: Chase torched Pittsburgh on Sunday night with 11 receptions and 231 yards, per ESPN's box score. He enters Monday with 878 receiving yards, 122 short of a sixth straight 1,000-yard season.

stories.text: 5: straight games with four or more TDs for Burrow
stories.summary: Joe Burrow went 35 of 44 for 406 yards and four touchdowns against Pittsburgh, per Local 12. He has now accounted for at least four passing and rushing touchdowns in five straight games, tying Peyton Manning's 2004 run for the longest streak in NFL history. Bengals.com and ESPN list his yardage as 409.

stories.text: Bengals visit Commanders on Monday Night Football
stories.summary: Cincinnati plays at Washington on Monday, Nov. 23, at 8:15 p.m. ET on ESPN, seeking a sixth straight win. Watch how the defense handles Jayden Daniels, who has 280 rushing yards. Former Commander Jonathan Allen returns to Northwest Stadium as a visitor.

teams.name: Cleveland Browns
teams.headline: Browns rest at 6-4 after another comeback win

stories.text: Watson rallies Browns past Texans 27-24 from 17 down
stories.summary: Deshaun Watson went 25 of 40 for 312 yards and led his sixth game-winning drive of the season. Quinshon Judkins scored the winning touchdown with 53 seconds left. Cleveland is 4-0 at home for the first time since 1963 and now takes its bye.

stories.text: Bye week brings no official report, but Ward and Graham watch
stories.summary: The Browns issued no injury report this week. Safety Ronnie Hickman (concussion) was back on the field, while cornerback Denzel Ward, Mason Graham, Carson Schwesinger, Quincy Williams and Tytus Howard watched practice. Schwesinger has played through an ankle injury since Oct. 11.

stories.text: Schwesinger piles up 13 tackles against Houston
stories.summary: Linebacker Carson Schwesinger recorded 13 tackles, eight solo, for his sixth double-digit game of the season. The Browns held Houston to 88 rushing yards.

stories.text: 78-13: Browns' first-quarter deficit across ten games
stories.summary: Opponents have outscored Cleveland 78-13 in first quarters this season, yet the Browns sit at 6-4 with the most double-digit comeback wins in franchise history, four. ESPN gives them a 59 percent playoff chance, per the report.

stories.text: Browns on bye, then Raiders on Sunday Night Football
stories.summary: Cleveland is off this week. Its next game is Sunday, Nov. 29, at 8:20 p.m. ET on NBC against the 4-6 Raiders at Huntington Bank Field. It is the Browns' first Sunday night home game since 2019.

teams.name: Pittsburgh Steelers
teams.headline: Steelers try to rebound from Bengals blowout in Philly

stories.text: Bengals bury Steelers 38-18, ending Pittsburgh's four-game streak
stories.summary: Pittsburgh fell behind 17-0 and 24-3 at halftime on Sunday night in Cincinnati. The loss dropped the Steelers to 6-3 and out of first place in the AFC North. The offense did not record a first down until well into the second quarter.

stories.text: Six Steelers questionable for Eagles, Herbig missed practice
stories.summary: Linebackers Patrick Queen (hand) and Nick Herbig (hip, ribs), safety DeShon Elliott (knee), receivers Michael Pittman Jr. and Roman Wilson, and guard Gennings Dunker are all questionable. Herbig did not practice Friday, while the others went full. Left guard Mason McCormick hurt his ankle against the Bengals.

stories.text: Payton Wilson leads Steelers with 17 tackles at Cincinnati
stories.summary: Linebacker Payton Wilson made 17 tackles against the Bengals, and Patrick Queen added 14. Jalen Ramsey forced a fumble in a game where neither side lost the ball.

stories.text: 21: completions for Burrow before Rodgers had one
stories.summary: Joe Burrow completed 21 passes before Aaron Rodgers recorded his first, which matched the most by one team before its opponent's first since play-by-play data began in 1978. Rodgers finished 15 of 29 for 143 yards and two touchdowns.

stories.text: Steelers at Eagles on Sunday afternoon on CBS
stories.summary: Pittsburgh plays at 2-7 Philadelphia on Sunday, Nov. 22, at 1 p.m. ET on CBS at Lincoln Financial Field. The Steelers need a response after Sunday night's loss. Watch the status of Herbig and Queen on defense.

teams.name: Houston Texans
teams.headline: Texans stomp Colts for first home win

stories.text: Texans bury Colts 26-3 for first home win of 2026
stories.summary: Houston lost its first four home games, then used a smothering defense and three C.J. Stroud touchdown passes to beat Indianapolis on Thursday night. The Colts managed a season-low 167 yards and no touchdowns. The win moved the Texans to 4-6.

stories.text: Braswell carted off with knee injury on opening kickoff
stories.summary: Defensive end Chris Braswell left on a cart with a right knee injury right after the opening kickoff Thursday. Houston played without defensive end Danielle Hunter (hamstring), wide receiver Marvin Harrison Jr. (hamstring) and running back Woody Marks (concussion). The team has not posted a Braswell timeline in the sources checked.

stories.text: Will Anderson Jr. leads the NFL with 11.5 sacks
stories.summary: Anderson dropped Daniel Jones in the end zone for a third-quarter safety and finished with two tackles for loss. His 11.5 sacks lead the league. The Yahoo report card gave Houston's defensive line an A-.

stories.text: 3: straight games with three TD passes for Stroud
stories.summary: Stroud went 21 of 27 for 194 yards and three touchdowns against Indianapolis. It was his third straight game with three touchdown passes, a first in his career. David Montgomery added 107 yards on 26 carries in his return from a groin injury, Houston's first 100-yard rusher this season.

stories.text: Texans host Ravens on November 29
stories.summary: Houston plays Baltimore at home on Nov. 29. Stroud called the Indianapolis win a possible start to something, and the Texans now need to show it was not a one-night fix. Kickoff time and network were not in the source.

teams.name: Indianapolis Colts
teams.headline: Colts held to 3 points, QB job in question

stories.text: Colts offense collapses in 26-3 loss, Jones job in doubt
stories.summary: Indianapolis lost its sixth game in seven tries and did not score a touchdown for the first time since November 2024. Coach Shane Steichen said he will evaluate everything, including whether Daniel Jones keeps the starting job. Anthony Richardson entered with about seven minutes left and missed both throws.

stories.text: Carlies to IR as Colts secondary and line stay thin
stories.summary: Linebacker Jaylon Carlies (neck) went on injured reserve this week. Cornerbacks Sauce Gardner (calf) and Charvarius Ward (knee) and tackles Bernhard Raimann (concussion) and Jalen Travis (knee) missed practice early in the week. Running back Seth McGowan strained a hamstring Thursday and did not return. Sources differ on Gardner's final status, but ESPN lists him out for the game.

stories.text: Daniel Jones struggles: 12 of 27 for 144 yards
stories.summary: Jones threw an interception to Kamari Lassiter and completed fewer than half his passes against Houston. Pressure and a thin secondary behind him left little rhythm. Steichen would not commit to Jones as the starter after the game.

stories.text: 167: Colts' season-low yards, with 38 on the ground
stories.summary: Indianapolis gained just 167 total yards Thursday, including 38 rushing. Kicker Spencer Shrader hit a 34-yard field goal, missed from 56, and had a 62-yard try blocked by Logan Hall. The three points were the only ones on the board.

stories.text: Colts host Giants on November 29
stories.summary: Indianapolis returns home to face the New York Giants on Nov. 29 at 3-8. The quarterback decision and the health of the cornerbacks and tackles are the items to watch. Kickoff time and network were not in the source.

teams.name: Jacksonville Jaguars
teams.headline: Jaguars at Giants with 7-2 mark on the line

stories.text: First-place Jaguars visit Giants with AFC South lead
stories.summary: Jacksonville is 7-2 after three straight wins and leads the AFC South. It is the franchise's best start through nine games since 1999. The Jaguars travel to face the NFC East-leading Giants today, and coach Liam Coen says the game will be won in the trenches.

stories.text: Striggow out, Hainsey out, Dickerson questionable
stories.summary: Defensive end Danny Striggow (concussion) was downgraded and did not travel. Center Robert Hainsey (knee) and defensive end B.J. Green II (forearm) are also out, and defensive tackle Matt Dickerson (neck) is questionable. Jonah Monheim is expected to start at center.

stories.text: Tuten healthy and driving the Jaguars backfield
stories.summary: Bhayshul Tuten is expected to play after managing injuries the past two games. He has 8 touchdowns, 815 scrimmage yards and 609 rushing yards this season, and 388 scrimmage yards with six touchdowns over his last four games. Nearly 90 percent of his rushing yards come after contact.

stories.text: +125: Jaguars' league-best point differential
stories.summary: Jacksonville leads the NFL with a +125 point differential and a +9 turnover margin. Trevor Lawrence has 2,284 passing yards and 21 touchdowns with 5 interceptions. A 30-point game today would set a franchise record with a fifth straight.

stories.text: Jaguars at Giants today, 4:25 p.m. ET on CBS
stories.summary: Jacksonville plays at MetLife Stadium on Sunday, Nov. 22, at 4:25 p.m. ET on CBS. Trade deadline additions Jordan Davis and Jessie Bates are expected to make their Jaguars debuts. Watch how the line handles the Giants without Hainsey at center.

teams.name: Tennessee Titans
teams.headline: Titans at Cowboys with Ward's audition on

stories.text: Titans lean into Cam Ward's audition at 1-8
stories.summary: Tennessee is 1-8 after a 40-23 loss to Jacksonville and has lost three straight. Coach Robert Saleh said the team must give Ward a real chance to prove he is the franchise quarterback. A loss to Dallas followed by a trip to Jacksonville would clinch a fifth straight losing season.

stories.text: Carnell Tate and Anthony Hill Jr. questionable at Dallas
stories.summary: Guard Fernando Carmona Jr. (ankle) is out. Wide receiver Carnell Tate (shoulder), linebacker Anthony Hill Jr. (neck), safety Tony Adams (concussion) and cornerback Micah Robinson (hip) are questionable, though all practiced fully on Friday. One report listed running back Tyjae Spears on injured reserve while the team report had him questionable, so his status is unclear.

stories.text: Cam Ward: 28 of 39, 231 yards, 2 TDs against Jacksonville
stories.summary: Ward also led the Titans with 39 rushing yards in last week's loss. Over his last two games he has 535 passing yards, four touchdowns and one interception, plus 80 rushing yards. His record as a starter is 4-22.

stories.text: 459: yards allowed by Titans, third game in a row at that mark
stories.summary: Jacksonville gained 459 yards and converted 7 of 14 third downs against Tennessee. It was the third straight game the Titans allowed at least 459 yards. Tennessee is 20-57 since 2022.

stories.text: Titans at Cowboys today, 1 p.m. ET on FOX
stories.summary: Tennessee (1-8) plays at AT&T Stadium against Dallas (4-6), kickoff at noon Central on FOX. It is the Titans' first trip to Dallas since 2018. Dak Prescott has 2,724 passing yards and 21 touchdowns, and Dallas ranks third in the NFL in passing yards per game. The game had not started in the sources checked.

teams.name: Denver Broncos
teams.headline: Broncos come off the bye hunting win No. 6 in a row

stories.text: Broncos return from the bye with a five-game win streak on the line
stories.summary: Denver (7-2) hosts Las Vegas today and goes for its sixth straight win after a two-week break. The Broncos have lost the ball only twice during the streak and carry a plus-six turnover margin. They have beaten the Raiders four straight times, and Las Vegas starts rookie Fernando Mendoza on the road for the first time.

stories.text: Lohner out, Brandon Jones questionable for Raiders
stories.summary: Tight end Caleb Lohner (foot) is out today. Safety Brandon Jones (hamstring) is questionable. Safety Talanoa Hufanga carried no game status on the report, and running back R.J. Harvey remains on injured reserve.

stories.text: Bo Nix keeps winning the close ones
stories.summary: Nix threw for 681 yards on 60-of-98 passing in the three games before the bye. He holds the NFL record for fourth-quarter game-winning drives by a quarterback through his third season, with 15. Denver has won 16 straight one-score games with him under center.

stories.text: 53: QB hurries by Denver's defense, most in the league
stories.summary: The Broncos lead the NFL with 53 quarterback hurries and 104 pressures, and they sit tied for fourth with 26 sacks. The weak spot is tackling. Denver leads the league with 74 missed tackles and has given up 126.1 rushing yards a game.

stories.text: Raiders at Broncos, today at 4:25 p.m. ET on CBS
stories.summary: Denver hosts Las Vegas at Empower Field at Mile High, with Andrew Catalon and Logan Ryan on the call. Watch whether the Broncos can run the ball against a Raiders defense that gives up 151.1 rushing yards a game, and whether they can contain Maxx Crosby.

teams.name: Kansas City Chiefs
teams.headline: Mahomes throws five TDs as Chiefs top Falcons

stories.text: Chiefs rout the Falcons 35-13 to hold the AFC West lead
stories.summary: Kansas City gained 471 yards to Atlanta's 368 on the road in Week 10 and moved to 7-2. The offense played well despite several absences. Special teams gave up a recovered onside kick and a muffed punt.

stories.text: Walker, Trey Smith and Moore out against Arizona
stories.summary: Running back Kenneth Walker III (groin), guard Trey Smith (concussion) and lineman Jaylon Moore (ankle) are out today. Defensive tackle Omarr Norman-Lott (knee) and Peter Woods (neck) are questionable. Smith left the Atlanta game for a concussion check.

stories.text: Emmett Johnson does it on the ground and through the air
stories.summary: Johnson ran 22 times for 101 yards against Atlanta and caught six passes for 70 yards and two touchdowns. Kansas City leaned on him with Walker inactive.

stories.text: 348: Mahomes' passing yards, with five touchdowns
stories.summary: Patrick Mahomes went 22-of-35 for 348 yards and five touchdown passes at Atlanta. Two rookies, Cyrus Allen and Andrew Armstrong, caught their first career touchdowns. The defense forced three turnovers.

stories.text: Cardinals at Chiefs, today at 1 p.m. ET on CBS
stories.summary: Kansas City hosts Arizona at Arrowhead Stadium. Watch how the Chiefs run the ball and protect Mahomes with Walker and Trey Smith out.

teams.name: Las Vegas Raiders
teams.headline: Mendoza's debut ends in a loss; Broncos next

stories.text: Mendoza's first start ends in a 21-13 loss to Seattle
stories.summary: The No. 1 overall pick went 11-of-13 for 90 yards in the first half as the Raiders led 10-7. The offense stalled after halftime and Seattle pulled away. Las Vegas has lost six of its last seven games.

stories.text: Brock Bowers questionable with ankle and quad injuries
stories.summary: Bowers hurt his right ankle against Seattle and did not play the second half. He also has a quadriceps issue. He missed Wednesday's practice, then was limited Thursday and Friday. Coach Klint Kubiak would not say whether he plays today.

stories.text: Maxx Crosby keeps showing up in the backfield
stories.summary: Crosby has recorded at least one sack and one tackle for loss in each of his last three games. Denver lists him first among the Raiders it needs to contain today.

stories.text: 0-for-7: Raiders' third-down mark in the second half
stories.summary: Las Vegas converted none of its seven third downs after halftime against Seattle. The Raiders rushed for 65 yards as a team, and Mendoza took six sacks. Two of them came from cornerback Devon Witherspoon.

stories.text: Raiders at Broncos, today at 4:25 p.m. ET on CBS
stories.summary: Las Vegas visits Denver at Empower Field at Mile High, with Mendoza making his first road start. Watch whether Bowers plays and whether the Raiders can protect their rookie quarterback against the Broncos' pass rush.

teams.name: Los Angeles Chargers
teams.headline: Chargers end the losing with a 23-20 win at Baltimore

stories.text: Chargers finally win, 23-20 over the Ravens
stories.summary: Los Angeles beat Baltimore on Monday night for its first win of the season after eight straight losses. The Chargers scored on their first drive, never trailed and played their first turnover-free game of the year. Jim Harbaugh said he was thrilled and wants to win every week.

stories.text: McConkey questionable, Henley out against the Jets
stories.summary: Wide receiver Ladd McConkey (back) is questionable after missing Week 9 and sitting out the Baltimore game. Linebacker Daiyan Henley (knee), cornerback Rodney Shelley (ankle) and safety Kendall Williamson (calf) are out. Receiver Brenen Thompson (hamstring) is doubtful.

stories.text: Omarion Hampton runs for 105 yards in the win
stories.summary: Hampton carried 22 times for 105 yards and a touchdown against Baltimore, his first 100-yard game of the season. He also scored on a one-yard run. Justin Herbert added a 22-yard touchdown run to open the scoring.

stories.text: 160: Chargers rushing yards, a season high
stories.summary: The Chargers ran for 160 yards against Baltimore behind a line that started three rookies. Herbert threw only 18 passes, a season low. The defense held the Ravens to 16 rushing yards.

stories.text: Jets at Chargers, today at 4:05 p.m. ET on FOX
stories.summary: Los Angeles hosts New York at SoFi Stadium. Watch McConkey's status and whether the run game keeps working without Henley on defense.

teams.name: Dallas Cowboys
teams.headline: Defense gave up 584 yards in a shootout loss

stories.text: Cowboys' defense gets torched for 584 yards in 46-40 loss to 49ers
stories.summary: San Francisco scored three touchdowns of 66 yards or more and ran for 214 yards at 7.4 per carry. It was the most yards Dallas has allowed at home in franchise history. The Cowboys managed five sacks, but the big plays decided it, and the defense now ranks last in the league in yards allowed.

stories.text: Booker and Bland ruled out against Tennessee
stories.summary: Right guard Tyler Booker and cornerback DaRon Bland both have high ankle sprains from the 49ers game and will sit. Tight end Jake Ferguson (knee and ankle) also missed practice all week, and safety P.J. Locke is in concussion protocol. T.J. Bass steps in for Booker.

stories.text: George Pickens returns and goes off for 145 yards
stories.summary: Pickens came back from his injury and caught 11 passes for 145 yards and three touchdowns, a career high in scores. Dak Prescott threw five touchdowns on 343 yards in the same game. It was a big night for the offense in a loss.

stories.text: 2,724: Prescott's passing yards, third in the NFL
stories.summary: Prescott has thrown for 2,724 yards and 21 touchdowns, and his 78.2 QBR also ranks third in the league. Dallas scores 28.6 points a game but allows 28.2, which explains the 4-6 record.

stories.text: Titans visit AT&T Stadium Sunday at 1 p.m. ET on FOX
stories.summary: Dallas hosts a Tennessee team that is 1-8 and has lost three straight. The Cowboys are home favorites, but they must patch a thin offensive line and secondary. Watch whether the defense can stop giving up long plays.

teams.name: New York Giants
teams.headline: Third QB McCarthy faces the 7-2 Jaguars

stories.text: Giants lean on third quarterback J.J. McCarthy after Dart injury
stories.summary: McCarthy, cut by Minnesota, is New York's third quarterback this season and is learning the offense on a short week. The Giants still lead the NFC East at 5-3-1, but a 24-21 loss to Washington on Thursday narrowed the margin. Dallas and Washington both remain in the race.

stories.text: Likely misses Friday practice with a groin injury
stories.summary: Tight end Isaiah Likely did not practice Friday, but no Giant carries a game designation. Safety Elijah Campbell and cornerback Nic Jones were limited with knee issues. Running back Cam Skattebo (hamstring) and cornerback Deonte Banks (shoulder) practiced fully.

stories.text: McCarthy sets career highs in a losing effort
stories.summary: McCarthy threw for 293 yards, a career best, in his first home start for the Giants. He hit Likely on a 66-yard touchdown in the fourth quarter. Rasul Douglas intercepted his final pass with under a minute left.

stories.text: 7: Likely's receiving touchdowns, most among tight ends
stories.summary: Likely caught nine passes for a career-high 127 yards and a score against Washington. His seven touchdown catches lead all tight ends this season. The Giants also have 50 or more scrimmage yards from Skattebo in seven of eight games.

stories.text: Jaguars visit MetLife Sunday at 4:25 p.m. ET on CBS
stories.summary: Jacksonville is 7-2 and leads the NFL with a plus-125 point differential. The Giants have not beaten the Jaguars at home since 2010. Watch whether the pass rush can get to Trevor Lawrence.

teams.name: Philadelphia Eagles
teams.headline: Seven straight losses, Steelers up next

stories.text: Eagles try to stop a seven-game skid against Pittsburgh
stories.summary: Philadelphia is 2-7 after its bye, with quarterback Joe Milton making a second straight start and the offense ranked at the bottom of the league. The team traded Jordan Davis and cut Hollywood Brown, and talk of draft position is growing. Jalen Hurts has been out for the season since blood clots were found in his lungs.

stories.text: Smith returns, Baun and Wicks sit out
stories.summary: DeVonta Smith practiced all week and is expected back from his hamstring injury. Linebacker Zack Baun (back) and receiver Dontayvion Wicks (ankle and foot) are out. Running back Will Shipley is questionable.

stories.text: Joe Milton ran for 64 yards in his first start
stories.summary: Milton threw for 169 yards and led the team in rushing with 64 yards in his first NFL start. He also took seven sacks. He gets another chance against a Steelers defense that comes off a bad loss.

stories.text: 61: years since the Steelers last won in Philadelphia
stories.summary: The Eagles have won 11 straight home games against Pittsburgh. The streak gives a struggling team one thing to hold onto Sunday. Pittsburgh has won six of its first nine games.

stories.text: Steelers visit Lincoln Financial Field Sunday at 1 p.m. ET on CBS
stories.summary: The league moved the game up from 4:25 p.m. to 1 p.m. because of the Eagles' losing streak. Philadelphia is a 4.5-point underdog. Watch Milton's protection and how Vic Fangio's defense handles Aaron Rodgers.

teams.name: Washington Commanders
teams.headline: Diggs' late TD beats Giants, Bengals on Monday

stories.text: Diggs' touchdown with 57 seconds left beats Giants 24-21
stories.summary: Jayden Daniels led a three-play, 71-yard drive that ended with a 32-yard touchdown pass to Stefon Diggs. Rasul Douglas then intercepted J.J. McCarthy to seal it. Washington now holds the NFC East tiebreaker over New York.

stories.text: McLaurin is done for the year with a torn patellar tendon
stories.summary: Terry McLaurin tore his left patellar tendon against San Francisco on Oct. 19 and needed surgery. Diggs and rookie Antonio Williams have taken over more work. Center Lucas Patrick and running backs Jacory Croskey-Merritt and Rachaad White were listed questionable for this week.

stories.text: Sonny Styles makes 13 tackles against New York
stories.summary: The linebacker finished with 13 tackles and a fourth-quarter tackle for loss on McCarthy. He leads Washington with 80 tackles on the season.

stories.text: 31st: Washington's pass defense ranking
stories.summary: The Commanders allow 244.8 passing yards a game. They face Cincinnati, which has the league's top passing offense at 298.8 yards a game. Joe Burrow has thrown for 2,795 yards and 27 touchdowns.

stories.text: Bengals visit Northwest Stadium Monday at 8:15 p.m. ET on ESPN
stories.summary: Washington does not play Sunday and closes Week 11 on Monday Night Football. Cincinnati is 7-2. Watch whether the Commanders can protect Daniels and slow Ja'Marr Chase.

teams.name: Chicago Bears
teams.headline: Bears chase a fifth straight win

stories.text: Bears survive four Williams picks to win four straight
stories.summary: Caleb Williams threw a career-high four interceptions against Tampa Bay on Nov. 8, then led the final drive. Colston Loveland's 38-yard catch set up Cairo Santos for a 38-yard field goal as time expired in a 27-24 win. Chicago sits at 7-2 and now has a bye week behind it.

stories.text: Simmons set to play, Gordon in doubt for Saints
stories.summary: Defensive tackle Jeffery Simmons missed Tuesday with a knee injury but practiced Thursday, and Dennis Allen said he expects no issues. Nickel corner Kyler Gordon missed his third straight practice with a shoulder injury and looks doubtful for Sunday.

stories.text: Williams is efficient since his hamstring return
stories.summary: Since coming back from a three-game absence, Williams has completed 73.8 percent of his passes for 860 yards and four touchdowns with no interceptions in the team's preview. Luther Burden III leads the receivers with 49 catches for 644 yards.

stories.text: 36: Williams' streak of low-pick games ended
stories.summary: Williams had gone 36 straight games with 20 or more attempts and fewer than two interceptions before the Tampa Bay game. The Bears still held the Buccaneers to 2 of 12 on third down and sacked Baker Mayfield four times.

stories.text: Saints visit Soldier Field Sunday at 1 p.m. ET on FOX
stories.summary: New Orleans is 3-6 and starts a rookie, Mason Murphy, at right tackle with Taliese Fuaga and center Erik McCoy out. Watch whether Kyle Monangai returns to a run game that has slowed since his injury. Sunday's result was not confirmed at the time of writing.

teams.name: Detroit Lions
teams.headline: Lions lose Hutchinson, bring five straight

stories.text: Hutchinson hurts his knee as Lions rout Patriots
stories.summary: Aidan Hutchinson went down after a sack of Drake Maye in Munich, and a source told the AP the injury will end his season. Detroit won 35-10 for its fifth straight win. Rookie Derrick Moore, who has four sacks, is the likely replacement.

stories.text: Joseph practices fully, Mays sits out for Detroit
stories.summary: Safety Kerby Joseph (knee) was a full participant Wednesday and Thursday. Center Cade Mays (ankle) did not practice either day. Cornerbacks D.J. Reed (hip), Ennis Rakestraw (shoulder) and Khalil Dorsey (ankle) were limited.

stories.text: Gibbs piles up 150 rushing yards in Munich
stories.summary: Jahmyr Gibbs ran for two touchdowns and more than 150 yards against New England. Two reports differ slightly on his total: 156 rushing yards in one, 153 rushing and 252 scrimmage in another. Tampa Bay's preview says he leads the NFL in rushing yards and touchdowns.

stories.text: 14.4: points allowed per game during the win streak
stories.summary: Detroit gave up 31.8 points per game during a 2-2 start. Over the five straight wins, that number dropped to 14.4. The Lions are also 5-0 at home this season.

stories.text: Buccaneers visit Ford Field Sunday at 1 p.m. ET on FOX
stories.summary: Tampa Bay is the opponent for Detroit's sixth-straight-win attempt. The Lions rank third in yards, but their pass defense is tied for 28th in yards allowed. Sunday's result was not confirmed at the time of writing.

teams.name: Green Bay Packers
teams.headline: Packers regroup on bye after eight-sack loss

stories.text: Packers take bye after Vikings sack Love eight times
stories.summary: Green Bay fell to 6-4 and last in the NFC North after a 30-10 loss at Lambeau Field. It was the first game since 2023 where a team allowed eight sacks and committed four turnovers. Matt LaFleur said the blame is shared and will not replace line coach Luke Butkus.

stories.text: Parsons could debut vs. Rams, Zeitler out in loss
stories.summary: Edge rusher Micah Parsons, coming back from a torn ACL, could make his season debut against the Rams. Guard Kevin Zeitler missed the Vikings game with a triceps injury. Safety Brandon Cisse (rib), Skyy Moore (ankle) and Bo Melton (thigh) left the game.

stories.text: McKinney leads the NFL with six interceptions
stories.summary: Safety Xavier McKinney is atop the league in interceptions, and Lukas Van Ness has a team-high six sacks. McKinney said the team has to respond after the Vikings loss.

stories.text: 74: takeaway points, tops in the NFL
stories.summary: Green Bay leads the league in points off takeaways and ranks second with 20 takeaways. The Packers have also held a winning record at the bye 14 times in 17 years.

stories.text: Rams on Netflix Wednesday at 8 p.m. ET
stories.summary: Green Bay is off this week, then plays at SoFi Stadium on Thanksgiving Eve, only the second Wednesday regular-season game in franchise history. Dec. 6 at New Orleans follows. Watch for Parsons' possible return.

teams.name: Minnesota Vikings
teams.headline: Vikings fly to Mexico City on a hot streak

stories.text: Cousins returns and Vikings crush Green Bay
stories.summary: Kirk Cousins, acquired from Las Vegas five days earlier, threw for 207 yards and two touchdowns in a 30-10 win at Lambeau. Minnesota snapped a two-game skid and moved to 7-2. Kevin O'Connell earned his 50th win, the fastest in franchise history.

stories.text: Addison out, Ward and Rodgers questionable for SNF
stories.summary: Receiver Jordan Addison (thumb) is out and will have surgery Monday. Safety Jay Ward (knee) and cornerback Isaiah Rodgers (quad) are questionable. T.J. Hockenson, Andrew Van Ginkel and Jeshaun Jones are expected to play.

stories.text: Rodriguez and the pass rush bury Jordan Love
stories.summary: Levi Drake Rodriguez had two of Minnesota's eight sacks, joined by Dallas Turner, Eric Wilson, Van Ginkel, Kyle Van Noy, Elijah Williams and Jalen Redmond. Van Ginkel also forced and recovered a fumble.

stories.text: 8: sacks, the most for Minnesota since 2018
stories.summary: Love had never taken more than five sacks in 56 previous starts. The eight sacks were the Vikings' most since nine against Miami in 2018.

stories.text: 49ers in Mexico City Sunday at 8:20 p.m. ET on NBC
stories.summary: San Francisco is 8-1 after a 46-40 win over Dallas. The Vikings play at Estadio Banorte and have five of their last seven games at U.S. Bank Stadium. Sunday's result was not confirmed at the time of writing.

teams.name: Atlanta Falcons
teams.headline: Falcons stew on a bye after three straight losses

stories.text: Falcons hit the bye at 3-7 with questions everywhere
stories.summary: Atlanta lost 35-13 to Kansas City, its third straight defeat, and now sits fourth in the NFC South. Coach Kevin Stefanski said the responsibility falls on him. The bye gives the staff a week to rework personnel, playcalling and approach.

stories.text: Falcons lose center Ryan Neuzil from the lineup
stories.summary: The Chiefs game was the first Atlanta played without center Ryan Neuzil, and Corey Levin took over as the new starter. Levin held up, but the line still piled up false starts. The postgame coverage names no new injuries, and the bye gives the team a week to heal.

stories.text: Bijan Robinson keeps producing in a losing season
stories.summary: Robinson has 951 rushing yards and six rushing touchdowns, averaging 5.1 yards per carry. He ran 16 times for 71 yards against Kansas City and scored his seventh touchdown of the year. The offense around him has sagged.

stories.text: 101.8: Falcons rushing yards per game over the last six
stories.summary: Atlanta ran for 181 yards a game over its first four contests. That number has fallen to 101.8 across the last six. The offense also ranks 24th in scoring at 20.1 points per game.

stories.text: Falcons are off Sunday, then travel to Minnesota
stories.summary: Atlanta has its Week 11 bye. In Week 12 the Falcons play at Minnesota at 1 p.m. ET, where Michael Penix Jr. faces former Falcons backup Kirk Cousins. Watch whether the run game and the offensive line clean up after the break.

teams.name: Carolina Panthers
teams.headline: Panthers lead the South, host Ravens Sunday

stories.text: Panthers steal the Saints game on the last snap
stories.summary: Ryan Fitzgerald kicked a 54-yard field goal as time expired to beat New Orleans 20-17 and put Carolina in first place in the NFC South at 4-5. The Panthers scored 10 points in the final 3:43 after trailing for the first time that day.

stories.text: Okereke and Simmons out against Baltimore
stories.summary: Linebacker Bobby Okereke (foot) and Isaiah Simmons (knee) are out for the Ravens game. Tight ends Darren Waller and Tommy Tremble, both with knee injuries, are questionable. Brady Christensen, Mike Jackson and Jonathon Brooks are questionable and sit in the injured reserve practice window.

stories.text: Chuba Hubbard carried the Carolina offense
stories.summary: Hubbard ran 27 times for 92 yards and two touchdowns against New Orleans. He also caught five passes for 80 yards. ESPN says he accounted for nearly 60 percent of the Panthers' offense.

stories.text: 17: Penalties that set a Panthers franchise record
stories.summary: Carolina was flagged 17 times for 152 yards against the Saints, a franchise high. It was the fourth game this season with 10 or more penalties, and the Panthers are 2-2 in them. Dave Canales wants the offsides and delay calls gone.

stories.text: Panthers host the Ravens at 1 p.m. ET on Fox
stories.summary: Carolina plays Baltimore at home Sunday at 1:00 p.m. ET on Fox. Watch the tight end room, with Waller and Tremble both questionable, and whether the Panthers can stay clean after last week's flag count.

teams.name: New Orleans Saints
teams.headline: Saints at Chicago after another last-play loss

stories.text: Saints fall 20-17 to Carolina on a final-play kick
stories.summary: New Orleans dropped to 3-6, 0-2 in the division and 1-4 at home. Charlie Smyth tied the game at 17 with 41 seconds left, but a 30-yard pass interference call on Kool-Aid McKinstry set up Carolina's winning kick.

stories.text: Saints thin on the line and at corner for Chicago
stories.summary: Center Erik McCoy (biceps), tackles Taliese Fuaga (knee) and Asim Richards (knee), and cornerback Martin Emerson Jr. (concussion) are out on the Friday report. Safety Justin Reid is out for a personal matter. Linebacker Pete Werner (hamstring) and cornerback Decamerion Richardson (thigh) are questionable.

stories.text: Jordyn Tyson caught 11 passes against Carolina
stories.summary: The rookie receiver led New Orleans with 11 catches for 80 yards in the loss. Tyson is listed with a chest injury on the Friday report with no game status given. Chris Olave had three catches for 30 yards.

stories.text: 1-4: Saints home record after the Carolina loss
stories.summary: New Orleans is 1-4 at the Superdome and 0-2 in NFC South play. The defense gives up 26.2 points per game. Tyler Shough threw for 187 yards with a touchdown, an interception and a lost fumble against Carolina.

stories.text: Saints visit the 7-2 Bears at 1 p.m. ET on Fox
stories.summary: New Orleans plays at Soldier Field on Sunday at 1:00 p.m. ET on Fox. Chicago is 7-2 and won 26-14 over the Saints last October. Watch how a short-handed offensive line holds up.

teams.name: Tampa Bay Buccaneers
teams.headline: Mayfield questionable as Bucs visit Detroit

stories.text: Bucs come off the bye with Mayfield's foot in question
stories.summary: Tampa Bay is 3-6 and plays at Detroit on Sunday at 1 p.m. ET. Baker Mayfield is questionable with a foot injury. If he cannot go, undrafted rookie Jalon Daniels starts. Todd Bowles says the plan would not change much.

stories.text: Mayfield questionable, Winfield and Hayes out
stories.summary: Mayfield (foot and right thumb) was limited Thursday and Friday and is questionable. Edge rusher Yaya Diaby (knee) is also questionable. Safety Antoine Winfield Jr. (ankle) and cornerback Josh Hayes (knee) are out.

stories.text: Bucky Irving has driven the Tampa Bay offense
stories.summary: Irving has 825 rushing yards and eight touchdowns this season. The Bucs lead the league at 163.9 rushing yards per game, and they face a Lions run defense ranked fifth.

stories.text: 16: Interceptions by the Bucs defense, tops in the NFL
stories.summary: Tampa Bay leads the league in picks, and Alex Anzalone and Zyon McCollum have four each. The defense has held eight straight opponents under 100 rushing yards. One more such game would set a franchise record.

stories.text: Bucs at Lions, Sunday 1 p.m. ET on Fox
stories.summary: Tampa Bay faces 7-2 Detroit at Ford Field. The Lions lost edge rusher Aidan Hutchinson to a season-ending knee injury in Week 10. Watch the Bucs' run game against Jahmyr Gibbs and the Detroit offense.

teams.name: Arizona Cardinals
teams.headline: Cardinals sink to 3-7 as QB chaos grows

stories.text: Cardinals fall to 3-7 as rookie Beck struggles in first start
stories.summary: Arizona lost 34-6 to the Rams on Nov. 15 with third-round rookie Carson Beck under center. Gardner Minshew went down with a season-ending elbow injury the week before, and Jacoby Brissett was traded to Baltimore on Nov. 6, so the job landed on Beck. The Cardinals now sit at 3-7.

stories.text: Beck questionable with a back issue before Kansas City
stories.summary: Chiefs.com lists Beck as questionable on the Friday report with a back problem. Guard Jon Gaines II (ankle) and defensive lineman Zach Carter (knee) are out. Arizona has 16 players on injury lists, tied with San Francisco for the most in the league.

stories.text: Carson Beck goes from third string to starter in 11 days
stories.summary: The 24-year-old rookie out of Miami and Georgia was third on the depth chart until Brissett left and Minshew got hurt. In the Hall of Fame game he went 15 of 19 for 188 yards and a touchdown. Coach Mike LaFleur said he knows the moment is not too big for Beck.

stories.text: 11: straight home losses for Arizona, a 427-day streak
stories.summary: The Cardinals have not won at State Farm Stadium in 427 days, and the league record is 14 straight home losses. Beck completed 11 of 18 passes for 108 yards with two interceptions against the Rams.

stories.text: At Kansas City, Sunday 1 p.m. ET on CBS
stories.summary: Arizona visits a 7-2 Chiefs team that is 4-0 against the Cardinals at Arrowhead. Watch the Arizona run defense, which allows 129.9 yards a game, fifth worst in the NFL, against Chiefs rookie Emmett Johnson, who is likely to carry the load with Kenneth Walker out with a groin injury.

teams.name: Los Angeles Rams
teams.headline: Rams roll into bye on four straight wins

stories.text: Rams crush Cardinals 34-6 for a fourth straight win
stories.summary: Los Angeles trailed 6-3 late in the second quarter, then scored two touchdowns in the last 1:06 of the half and pulled away. The 6-4 Rams head into the bye week with their winning streak intact, even without Puka Nacua and Davante Adams.

stories.text: Nacua out a good while with MCL and PCL strains
stories.summary: Coach Sean McVay said Nacua has MCL and PCL strains plus turf toe and will probably go on injured reserve. The bye week does not count toward the four-game minimum. Davante Adams (hamstring) and guard Steve Avila (hamstring) are also hurt.

stories.text: Stafford spreads it around for three touchdowns
stories.summary: Matthew Stafford went 18 of 26 for 249 yards and three touchdowns against Arizona. The scores went to Xavier Smith, Tyler Higbee and Davis Allen, and Blake Corum added a rushing touchdown.

stories.text: 9: different Rams caught a pass against Arizona
stories.summary: No Rams receiver had more than three catches in the win. With Nacua, Adams and tight end Terrance Ferguson out, Stafford leaned on Tutu Atwell, CJ Daniels and Konata Mumpfield, among others.

stories.text: Bye in Week 11, then Packers on Thanksgiving Eve
stories.summary: The Rams host Green Bay at SoFi Stadium on Wednesday, Nov. 25, at 8 p.m. ET on Netflix. Both teams are 6-4, and the Rams will have to show they can keep the offense humming without their top two receivers.

teams.name: San Francisco 49ers
teams.headline: 49ers 8-1 and set for Sunday night in Mexico City

stories.text: 49ers outlast Cowboys 46-40 to reach 8-1
stories.summary: San Francisco won a shootout in Arlington on Nov. 15. Christian McCaffrey scored on a 74-yard catch and a 66-yard catch that sealed it. The 49ers play Minnesota tonight in Mexico City.

stories.text: Evans, Greenlaw, Jones among questionable for Vikings
stories.summary: The Friday report lists WR Mike Evans (Achilles), LB Dre Greenlaw (neck), QB Mac Jones (illness), CB Nate Hobbs (adductor), DE Khalid Kareem (ankle) and RB Jordan James (calf) as questionable. McCaffrey and Trent Williams are listed only for rest and were full participants Thursday and Friday.

stories.text: Purdy throws a career-best 389 yards in Dallas
stories.summary: Brock Purdy went 22 of 28 for 389 yards, with touchdown passes of 74 and 66 yards to McCaffrey. McCaffrey finished with 223 scrimmage yards and three touchdowns, and Deebo Samuel returned from a three-game hamstring absence with two scores.

stories.text: 12.1: Purdy's yards per attempt against the blitz
stories.summary: That is the best mark in the league, according to a Week 11 preview. Minnesota blitzes on 72.3 percent of snaps, and San Francisco leads the NFL at 399.8 yards a game while ranking second at 31.2 points.

stories.text: Vikings tonight in Mexico City, 8:20 p.m. ET on NBC
stories.summary: San Francisco (8-1) meets Minnesota (7-2) at Estadio Banorte on Sunday Night Football. The Vikings have the league's top scoring defense at 14 points allowed per game, so watch how Purdy handles the pressure.

teams.name: Seattle Seahawks
teams.headline: Seahawks rest at 6-4 and eye Darnold's return

stories.text: Seahawks bye at 6-4, hopeful Darnold returns for 49ers
stories.summary: Seattle beat Las Vegas 21-13 on Nov. 15 behind Drew Lock and now sits in the seventh NFC playoff spot. Coach Mike Macdonald said he is optimistic Sam Darnold, who has missed two games with a cracked rib and quad injury, can play at San Francisco.

stories.text: Line injuries pile up while Darnold heals
stories.summary: Right tackle Abraham Lucas left the Raiders game in the second quarter, and running back George Holani (knee) went out in the first. Guard Quenton Nelson (knee) and tackle Charles Cross (ankle) were inactive. Lock played through elbow and oblique issues.

stories.text: Smith-Njigba tops 1,200 yards with seven games left
stories.summary: Jaxon Smith-Njigba caught eight passes for 171 yards and a 71-yard touchdown against the Raiders. He has 79 catches for 1,207 yards and 10 touchdowns, and he is the only NFL receiver over 1,000 yards. He also set a Seahawks record with 144 yards in the third quarter.

stories.text: 39: straight games without allowing a 100-yard rusher
stories.summary: Seattle held Las Vegas to 65 rushing yards and sacked rookie Fernando Mendoza six times. The streak includes the playoffs.

stories.text: On bye now, then at the 49ers on Nov. 29
stories.summary: Seattle visits first-place San Francisco (8-1) in Week 12. Kickoff time and network were not listed in the sources I read. Watch whether Darnold is cleared and whether Cross and Nelson return up front.
